info.title: API.SH: Fnac
info.description: The Fnac API from API.SH: public Fnac data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The products of any Fnac listing link (a brand page /m…, a shelf /n… or /nsh…, a selection page), in the same shape as search, with the page's filters. Department home pages that only show editorial blocks list no products (404). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 5 credits per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fnac-listing

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A fnac.com or fnac.be listing link.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Filter values from `facets[].values[].filter`, several separated by |.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Fnac product: title, brand and range, EAN, SKU and maker reference, current price and the offer behind it (seller, condition, shipping), every offer for the product (Fnac and marketplace sellers, new and used, with prices and shipping), availability, rating and review count (and the Fnac lab score where there is one), category and breadcrumbs, summary and full description, all specifications, images and videos, and the store shown for pick-up.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 5 credits per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fnac-product

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The Fnac product number (the digits after /a in product links, e.g. 18573408), or `product_id` from search for marketplace-only items (e.g. mp50416556).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Or a fnac.com or fnac.be product link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Customer reviews of a Fnac product, 10 per page: rating, title, text, date, whether it follows a verified purchase, the helpful votes, the reviewer's first name and initial (`author`) and the name and profile link as the page shows them (`author_name`, `author_url`); with the product's average rating, review count and star distribution. Sort by newest, most helpful, highest or lowest rating. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 5 credits per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fnac-reviews

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search the Fnac shop (France by default, Belgium with `country=be`): products with id (or `product_id` for marketplace-only items), title, link, image, the brand and range line, price and struck-through price, rating and review count, seller (Fnac or a marketplace seller) with its type and location, condition, availability online and in a store, and key specifications; the total and page count; and every filter the shop shows for the query (sold by Fnac, price range, brand, format, technical attributes). Filter with `facets[].values[].filter` values and sort by price or rating. Some words lead to a department page instead of results: then `items` is empty and `redirected_to` gives that page (use it with /fnac/v1/listing). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 5 credits per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/fnac-search

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Filter values from `facets[].values[].filter` (e.g. Fnac!attributes.brand__Marque, or 1!13 for sold by Fnac), several separated by |.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
